title: 第5章 融合灵魄决第6章冰儿
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
“道友很有眼力，此物蕴含妖兽精魄，二百灵石都买不到，若非来历有问题，也不会给这么低的价格！”
李安的脸藏在黑袍中，看不清楚，只是声音极为沉稳的道：
“老道爷，明人不说暗话，这玉佩中的精魄不过掩人耳目，不过倒是一块古玉，五十灵石拿下，也算是给了你一个高价，为你开个张？”
听到这话，老头摇头道：“一百灵石，概不还价！”
李安见此，淡淡的道：“我这里只有五十块灵石，老道爷若是觉得价格太低，我可以再给你一枚蕴含回春丹药力的丹丸。”
“哦？”听到这话，老头顿时有了一些兴趣，“丹丸可在身上？”
李安从怀中摸出一瓶，缓缓将其打开。
顿时，淡淡的丹香弥漫而出。
丹香入鼻，老头子的气息明显有些粗重，这种疗伤的丹药，很合他心意。
“不错！这丹丸药性很浓烈，你若是还能再给我一枚，这玉佩就卖给你了！”
李安心头一动，但还是叹息一声道：“此物难得，目前身上只一枚。”
老头见此，有些遗憾，不过认真地想了想，还是点头同意了。
于是五十块灵石，加上一枚丹丸，李安顺利将那玉佩拿到了手中。
握着这块玉佩，李安的内心顿时有些激动起来。
转身离开了此地，片刻后，找了一处无人的小巷子，李安有些激动的将随身携带的《青木功》、《小魂决》摆放在了身前。
随着这两道功法的出现，李安眼前顿时有雾气翻涌。
【发现不入流青木功，不入流小魂决，八品下妖兽功法——兽灵决，是否消耗十缕阴阳气，将其融合成适合人族修行的功法？】
【当前阴阳气：十八缕。】
阴阳气不多了。

可能融合出人族可以修行的八品功法，十缕阴阳气，绝对非常值得！
李安心头一动，顿时有阴阳气从阴阳炉中翻涌而出，迅速在他身前汇聚，然后将三种不同的功法，迅速糅合到一起。
不久后，灵光一闪，李安手中顿时多出了一本功法书册。
凝神一看。
【《灵魄决》，八品上功法，取自妖兽功法之玄妙，以灵力、妖魄为核心，既修灵力，兼修灵魂……】
八品上的功法！
而且还是灵力与灵魂同修！
这种层次的功法，在丹圣宗都属于极为罕见的功法，毕竟就是筑基修士都可以继续修行。
这功法也不愧是八品上功法，灵魂也能一并修行。
只是，或许融入了妖族功法，这功法修行的方式有些古怪。
虽然也能按部就班的修行，不过想要加快破境，却需要吸收妖兽精魄。
和妖族吞噬血肉修行的办法有些相似，颇为野蛮……或者说霸道！
有了此等灵力与灵魂双修的功法，将其修行成功，到时候兰月儿想要吸收自己的灵魂，反倒是可能被自己当做妖魄给吸收了。
李安颇为激动。
然后就尝试初步修行。
或许是因为这功法融入了《青木功》的缘故，李安修行起来并没有那种生涩之感。
而且他的灵魂得到过壮魄丹的加持，修行起来更是事半功倍。
只是修行了半个时辰。

"Fellow Taoist is very discerning. This thing contains the essence of monsters and beasts. You can't even buy it with two hundred spirit stones. If there was no problem with the origin, you wouldn't give such a low price!"
Li An's face was hidden in his black robe and could not be seen clearly, but he said in a very calm voice:
"Old Taoist Master, if you are wise and don't tell secrets, the essence in this jade pendant is just a piece of ancient jade. If you take it with fifty spiritual stones, it can be regarded as giving you a high price and opening a business for you?"
Hearing this, the old man shook his head and said: "One hundred spiritual stones, no counter-offer!"
Seeing this, Li An said calmly: "I only have fifty spiritual stones here. If the old Taoist feels that the price is too low, I can give you another pill that contains the power of the rejuvenation pill."
"Oh?" After hearing this, the old man suddenly became interested, "Do you have the pills with you?"
Li An took out a bottle from his arms and opened it slowly.
Immediately, a faint fragrance of elixir filled the air.
The fragrance of elixir entered his nose, and the old man's breath was obviously a bit heavy. This kind of healing elixir was very suitable for him.
"That's right! This pill has very strong medicinal properties. If you can give me another pill, I will sell you this jade pendant!"
Li An's head moved, but he still sighed and said: "This thing is rare. I only have one on my body at the moment."
Seeing this, the old man felt a little regretful, but after thinking about it seriously, he nodded in agreement.
So with fifty spiritual stones and a pill, Li An successfully got the jade pendant in his hand.
Holding this jade pendant, Li An suddenly felt excited.
He turned around and left the place. After a while, he found a deserted alley. Li An excitedly placed the "Aoki Kung" and "Little Soul Art" he carried with him in front of him.
With the appearance of these two techniques, mist suddenly surged in front of Li An's eyes.
[It was discovered that the Buruyu Aoki Kung Fu, the Buruyu Xiaohun Jue, and the eighth-level demon beast technique—the Beast Spirit Jue—would consume ten strands of yin and yang energy and fuse them into a technique suitable for human cultivation? 】
[Current yin and yang energy: eighteen rays. 】
There is not much yin and yang energy left.
It is possible to fuse the eighth-level skills and ten strands of yin and yang energy that humans can practice, which is definitely worth it!
As soon as Li An moved his head, yin and yang energy suddenly surged out from the yin and yang furnace, quickly gathered in front of him, and then quickly blended three different techniques together.
Not long after, an idea flashed, and an exercise book suddenly appeared in Li An's hand.
Take a closer look.
["Spirit Soul Jue", an eighth-grade upper level skill, is derived from the mystery of monster skills, with spiritual power and demon soul as the core, cultivating both spiritual power and soul...]
Eighth-level skills!
And he is also a spiritual and soul practitioner!
This level of skills is extremely rare in the Alchemy Sect. After all, even Foundation Establishment monks can continue to practice it.
This skill is worthy of being an eighth-level skill, and the soul can also practice it at the same time.
However, it may be integrated with the demon clan's skills, and the way of practicing this skill is a bit weird.
Although you can practice step by step, if you want to break through the realm faster, you need to absorb the spirit of monsters.
It's somewhat similar to the demon tribe's method of devouring flesh and blood, which is quite barbaric...or rather domineering!
With this kind of spiritual power and soul cultivation technique, if it is successfully practiced, when Lan Yue'er wants to absorb her own soul, she may be absorbed by her as a demon.
Li An was quite excited.
Then try the initial practice.
Perhaps because this technique is integrated into the "Aoki Kung Fu", Li An does not feel that jerky when practicing it.
Moreover, his soul has been blessed by Zhuangpo Dan, and his practice is even more effective with half the effort.
I just practiced for half an hour.
